claims.claim_text_normalized: SSD eliminates the bounding box proposal generation and subsequent pixel or feature resampling stages, encapsulating all computation in a single network.
claims.evidence_quote_short: it completely eliminates proposal generation and subsequent pixel or feature resampling stages and encapsulates all computation in a single network.

claims.claim_text_normalized: SSD uses a small convolutional filter to predict object categories and offsets in bounding box locations.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Our improvements include using a small convolutional filter to predict object categories and offsets in bounding box locations

claims.claim_text_normalized: SSD applies separate predictors for different aspect ratio detections and uses multiple feature maps from later network stages to perform detection at multiple scales.
claims.evidence_quote_short: using separate predictors (filters) for different aspect ratio detections, and applying these filters to multiple feature maps from the later stages of a network in order to perform detection at multiple scales.

claims.claim_text_normalized: SSD300 achieves 74.3% mAP on VOC2007 test at 59 FPS on a Nvidia Titan X.
claims.evidence_quote_short: SSD achieves 74.3% mAP on VOC2007 test at 59 FPS on a Nvidia Titan X

claims.claim_text_normalized: SSD512 achieves 76.9% mAP on VOC2007 test, outperforming a comparable state-of-the-art Faster R-CNN model.
claims.evidence_quote_short: for 512× 512 input, SSD achieves 76.9% mAP, outperforming a comparable state-of-the-art Faster R-CNN model.

claims.claim_text_normalized: SSD has much better accuracy than other single stage methods even with a smaller input image size.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Compared to other single stage methods, SSD has much better accuracy even with a smaller input image size.

claims.claim_text_normalized: SSD is very sensitive to the bounding box size and has much worse performance on smaller objects than bigger objects.
claims.evidence_quote_short: SSD is very sensitive to the bounding box size. In other words, it has much worse performance on smaller objects than bigger objects.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Data augmentation is crucial for SSD performance, improving mAP by 8.8% with the extensive sampling strategy.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Data augmentation is crucial. ... Table 2 shows that we can improve 8.8% mAP with this sampling strategy.
